payload.text: Very disappointed with Blinkit. My order was delivered with a missing item (Cadbury Dairy Milk Mini Treats worth ₹149). I reported it immediately and even tried calling the delivery partner, but received no response. Blinkit rejected my complaint based only on internal records without providing any evidence that the item was packed or delivered. After multiple follow-ups and no fair resolution, I had to escalate the matter to the National Consumer Helpline. Poor customer support.
